title: Council chamber in morning sun
subject: a small medieval war council chamber of rough ashlar walls with a heavy oak map table in the middle covered by a parchment map and small wooden army pieces; on the far wall a tall deep-set leaded window with a stone window seat and a worn cushion, the sun pouring through it in long dusty beams onto the table; beside the window a large faded painted map of the realm hung on the wall on a wooden rod; an iron-bound oak chest with rolled charts in a basket; a tall iron floor candelabrum; a narrow oak shelf of ledgers and a brass hourglass; rush matting on the plank floor

title: Chart room of the staff
subject: a medieval chart room of a royal military staff, rough stone walls, a heavy oak map table in the middle covered by a parchment map and small wooden army pieces; along the side walls tall oak racks of pigeonholes stuffed with rolled maps and sealed letters, a slanted reading lectern with an open ledger, a map chest with wide shallow drawers, quills and an inkwell on a side table; on the far wall two tall narrow leaded windows side by side, sunlight streaming through both in slanting dusty beams across the room and onto the floorboards

title: Keep chamber with hearth
subject: the upper chamber of a castle keep used as a war room, rough stone walls, a heavy oak map table in the middle covered by a parchment map and small wooden army pieces; on the far wall a deep arched window embrasure with leaded glass and a stone seat, sun beams slanting through it across dusty air; on the left wall a large hooded stone fireplace with a low banked fire and iron fire dogs; a faded woollen tapestry of a hunting scene on the right wall; a heavy iron ring chandelier hanging low with tallow candles; a carved oak chair and a bench by the table
